description: Replay pending recorded events against their certified reference (a PASSED gate run for the same model) plus the input-matched baseline. Verdicts land asynchronously — poll edgegate_recorder_status. Events with no certified reference resolve to no_reference.

device_id.description: Optional — only replay events from this device.

limit.description: Max pending events to replay this call. Default 100.

name: edgegate_trigger_replay
